sample_unit: AI-generated informed consent forms for ophthalmological procedures

links.outcome: Real-world applicability of AI-generated consent forms in the Indian setting, judged by ophthalmology faculty
links.effect: 40% of consents generated by both chatbots were not fit for use in Indian scenarios.
links.quote: However, 40% of the consents generated by both chatbots were not fit to be used in Indian scenarios.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the correctness, completeness, readability, and real-world applicability of informed consent forms generated by ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek without testing a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
